races.paceDynamic: William F Browne is the only confirmed front runner in this 16-runner field, meaning he can dictate a comfortable, uncontested pace from the front. Game Point may sit prominently behind him, but the bulk of this large field comprises hold-up horses including Hey Now, First Ascent, Lilac Lady, and the lightly-raced Strategic Move. With minimal early pace pressure, the tempo will be moderate early before quickening from the second-last hurdle. This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent racers and early positioned horses who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the hold-up brigade in such a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If William F Browne jumps cleanly and sets sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: He controls the race from pillar to post while the pack behind gets into trouble, allowing prominent racers to pick up the pieces. The moderate early pace suits horses that can sit handy and avoid the scrum.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If Game Point or Saint Peregrine track the leader perfectly and pounce late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where positioning trumps pure ability, with prominently-raced horses having crucial first run on the field. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind the large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or the front runners fade dramatically
scenarios.body: Strategic Move and Hey Now get the strong gallop they need to unleash their finishing kicks from the rear. This requires the early leaders to go too fast or hit the wall completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If William F Browne fades badly and no one takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle with any horse in contention, creating a lottery finish. Multiple horses hit the front in the final furlong with the winner coming from anywhere.

watchPoints.text: William F Browne's jumping fluency is crucial as the only pace angle - any early mistakes could derail the tempo completely
Traffic problems will be severe for hold-up horses like Strategic Move and Hey Now given the 16-runner field size
Saint Peregrine needs to show he's back to his June form after 173 days off to be competitive from his prominent style
Game Point's settling ability will determine if he can exploit his tactical advantage from a prominent position
Strategic Move's market support will indicate connections' confidence in his lightly-raced profile

races.paceDynamic: Beir Bua is the only confirmed front-runner and will set a sustainable pace from the front without pressure in this large maiden field. The prominent runners Crystabel and Lumiere Du Large will track behind, with the vast majority of the 17-runner field positioned in midfield or held up. This creates a scenario where the early pace will be moderate, setting up a long sprint from the final bend. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to Beir Bua and hold-up horses with finishing speed, as the lack of early pressure will preserve stamina for a competitive finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Crystabel or similar prominent runner can sit close to Beir Bua and outstay her
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace preserves stamina for those tracking the leader, allowing them to maintain their position and find extra in the closing stages. Beir Bua may fade after doing the donkey work, with her tracker inheriting the lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses can get into contention and the pace becomes a sprint from 3f out
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means hold-up horses won't be too far back, and with Kennedy aboard, connections clearly expect a staying test that suits closers. A bunch finish develops where class and finishing kick decide.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Beir Bua gets easy fractions and the field can't close her down
scenarios.body: Having made all successfully before, Beir Bua could exploit the lack of pace pressure to dictate throughout. Her prominent style becomes leading when unchallenged, and she proves too strong in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unexposed newcomers has significant improvement in them
scenarios.body: Several lightly-raced types make debuts or have minimal experience, and in a weak maiden one could have been working significantly better at home. The moderate pace gives them time to find their rhythm.

watchPoints.text: Beir Bua could get easy fractions on the front end and prove very hard to peg back in the straight
Lumiere Du Large has Jack Kennedy aboard for Gordon Elliott, suggesting they expect a big run despite recent poor form
Several lightly-raced types including Leva Deva and Shegotrhythmtspare could have significant improvement hidden
Crystabel was close to winning when falling at Killarney and represents value if staying on her feet
The large field of 17 could cause traffic problems for hold-up horses if they get too far back early

races.paceDynamic: Bangor Lady is the only confirmed front-runner and will make the running unchallenged early, setting a sustainable pace that won't break up the field. Bowgate Street, Gold Gatewood and Jr Mahon will track in prominent positions but none are natural pace-pressers. The lack of early speed creates a tactical race where the pace will only quicken from the second-last hurdle. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late finishes, as they'll get the perfect scenario of a steady gallop followed by a sprint finish that plays to their strengths.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bangor Lady sets uncontested fractions and the pace doesn't quicken until late
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get perfect conditions to unleash finishing kicks in the final half-mile. Those with tactical speed and stamina reserves will sweep past the early leaders who've done too much work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Bowgate Street or Jr Mahon apply more pressure than expected mid-race
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours those positioned handily who can quicken without losing ground. Hold-up horses may find too much to do if the gallop becomes truly run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Exploitation
scenarios.trigger: If Bangor Lady gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: Her family connections with trainer Ryan and the lack of pace pressure allows her to dictate completely and steal the race. The field may not react quickly enough to her acceleration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos And Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make jumping errors or there are significant fallers at crucial hurdles
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where form goes out the window and an unfancied runner capitalizes on others' misfortune. Late-running outsiders can benefit from cleaner jumps.

races.paceDynamic: Lady's Choice will lead with no other confirmed front runners in this 19-runner field, creating a likely steady gallop without early pressure. Ladiam and Lariat provide the prominent tracker element, while the vast majority are hold-up horses including Tomas O Maille, Ilbdare, Mother Ship and Dunany Point. With Lady's Choice prone to fading and no genuine pace pressure expected, this sets up as a moderate gallop that will turn into a sprint finish. This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent trackers and forward hold-up horses who can position close enough to strike, rather than horses relying on long finishing kicks from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Benefits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Lady's Choice maintains an uncontested lead creating a moderate gallop
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows prominent runners to travel comfortably before striking, while pure hold-up horses get strung out when the tempo lifts. Forward-positioned horses with tactical pace can exploit the predictable tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Collapse Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Lady's Choice fades dramatically in the final half-mile after setting weak fractions
scenarios.body: The slow pace becomes a stamina test where horses with strong finishing kicks can sweep up from off the pace. Hold-up performers with proven staying power benefit from the crawling early tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Early Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Lariat or Button Rock force the pace early alongside Lady's Choice
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates a more genuine test of stamina over this extended trip. Horses with proven ability at the distance can capitalize on a more searching gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lady's Choice goes very slowly with no pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery where any horse getting a clear run can win in a blanket finish. Long-absent horses returning to form or lightly-raced improvers can shock at big prices.

watchPoints.text: Lady's Choice may not see out the trip despite leading throughout, as her fade-in-finish pattern suggests stamina limitations over this extended distance
Ladiam and Mother Ship both face fitness concerns after long absences, though both have strong connections and course experience
Button Rock gets blinkers for the first time with Jack Kennedy riding for Gordon Elliott, suggesting stable confidence despite poor recent form
Several hold-up horses including Tomas O Maille and Celtic Crossing face significant fitness questions after extended breaks
Multiple reserves Jumble Light, Listentomewillya and Doyen Wolf could gain starts if withdrawals occur, with Listentomewillya the most interesting as a handicap debutant

races.paceDynamic: Earl Neigh and Survivors Sister are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead over this stamina-sapping 3m2f trip. Their duel will create an honest gallop from the outset, with Jumping Susie and Le Grand Vert likely to track them prominently. The sustained pace over the extended distance will test stamina reserves severely in the closing stages. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy early and produce a finishing kick when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Artists Profit
scenarios.trigger: If Earl Neigh and Survivors Sister engage in their expected front-running battle
scenarios.body: The honest early gallop will set up perfectly for closers like The Miracle Man, Gerrods Wish and Jeriko De Baune to pick off the tiring leaders. These hold-up specialists can time their runs to perfection as the front pair fade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the perfect stalking position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: Jumping Susie or Le Grand Vert could benefit from the pace battle ahead while staying close enough to strike when the leaders falter. Their positioning allows them to avoid the early speed battle while maintaining striking distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Earl Neigh's step up to 3m2f unlocks improved stamina on handicap debut
scenarios.body: His opening mark may prove generous and the extended trip could suit his style better than shorter distances suggest. Survivors Sister lacks recent form but her Limerick win showed she can dominate when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners fail to engage properly or encounter jumping issues
scenarios.body: The race becomes a muddling affair that doesn't play to the hold-up horses' strengths, allowing a midfield runner to steal it. This scenario benefits horses who can adapt tactically rather than those relying on a strong pace.

watchPoints.text: Earl Neigh and Survivors Sister could set unsustainable fractions if they lock horns too early over this stamina test
Evans Secret faces a fitness test after 303 days off and his fresh record suggests he needs the run
Jeriko De Baune pulled up last time and needs to prove that was just a bad day at the office
The Miracle Man's hold-up style perfectly suits the likely pace scenario with his course form a major plus
Jumping Susie's headgear changes suggest connections expect improvement from her prominent racing style
